(133)༄༅/ /grub mchog spyi la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgya gar lugs dngos grub thig le 'khyil ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (133)༄༅// grub mchog spyi la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgya gar lugs dngos grub thig le 'khyil ba bzhugs so//

(134)༄༅// na mo gu ru ma hā sid+dhi la b+dhe bh+yaḥ rnam rtog la brten mi rtog brnyes// mi rtog khong nas ye shes shar// zung 'jug grub pa mchog rnams dang*// dbyer med rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud// bla ma'i rim pa las 'ongs pa// byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs zab mo// grub thob brgyud pa'i zhal lung ltar// rang rtog 'khrul dris ma bslad dgod// grub pa'i spyi mes chen po slob dpon rta mchog zhabs dang*/ rtsod dus kyi dpal he ru ka zhi ba sbas pa'i gdams ngag gis bka' srol ltar slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal lugs kyi grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gtso bor gyur pa'i grub chen gang la'ang sbyor du rung ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal gyi yo byad nye bar bsdog /'byor na phyi nang gi mchod pa ji ltar rigs pa bshams la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa rnams spyi ltar sngon du btang*/ maṇ+ḍal byi dor byas la/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi swā hā/ zhes skyon sbyang*/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dri bzang dang ba byung gis skyang nul bya/ de'i dbus su lag pa g.yas pas me tog gsar pa'i tshom bu bkod la/ hūm̐ su me ru ma dh+ye ma/ shar du bkod la/ ya sūrba bi de ha dwī ba/ lhor bkod la/ ra dzaṃ pu dwī pa dak+ṣi ṇaḥ nub tu bkod la/ wa go da nī ya ba bash+tsa ma dwī pa/ byang du bkod la/ la urtar (135)ku ru dī pa/ shar gyi g.yas g.yon du bkod/ yaṃ aḥde hash+tsa bi de ha/ lho'i g.yas g.yon du bkod la/ raṃ raḥtsa ma rash+tsa a pa tsa ma raḥ nub kyi g.yas g.yon du bkod la/ waṃ waḥsha ṣa urtar mat+t+ri ṇaḥ byang gi g.yas g.yon tu bkod la/ laṃ laḥku ra wa ko ra wā/ shar gyi shar dang nub kyi nub tu bkod la/ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya bhūṣi ta/ zhes brjod nas/ rin chen sna tshogs rang bzhin ni// ri rab lcog brgyad yang dag ldan// gling bzhi gling phran ldan pa 'di// 'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol//

zhes me tog dor la maṇ+ḍal mdun stegs su bkod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dag pa ye shes kyi zhing khams rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhom du med pas yongs su bskor ba'i snying por gzhal med khang rgyu dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ dur khrod rol pa'i yo byad dang lha rdzas kyi nyer spyod mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal sa ra ha/ sku mdog dkar dmar bram ze'i cha byad can/ bgres rgud spangs pa'i lang tsho 'gyur ba med pa'i gang ba la rtag tu gnas pa/ dbu skra jo bregs ras dmar po'i aṅga rag gsol zhing phyag gnyis gnyug ma'i gnas lugs mtshon par byed pa'i mda' srong (136)ba'i phyag rgya can/ zhabs phyed skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i g.yon nas rig ma ye shes kyi rnal 'byor ma mda' mkhan mo'i tshul can gyis brten pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes gyi gzi 'od phyogs brgyar 'bar bas bzod par dka' ba'i zil can nyi ma'i snying po lta bu/ srid pa gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i lta stangs kyis rab tu dpa' ba'i nyams can/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po chos kyi sku la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa/ lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las kyi rnam par rol pa zad mi shes pa can/ dpa' bo dang ḍā ki rgya mtsho lta bu'i mchod cing brjid pa dang*/ sa gsum gyi dbang po rnams kyi ri mor byed bzhin pa'i sku can gyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gdod nas dbyer mi phyed pa/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma kun 'dus/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun kun 'dus/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma kun 'dus// brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag

/'khor 'das kyi dpal mgon/ skyabs gnas kun gyi spyi gzugs chen por mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ āḥdapal ldan rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo hūm̐/ ad+ya sid+dh+ya māṃ/ zhes lan mang du phyag bya/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// mda' bsnun khyod zhabs pad la 'dud// rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma la// dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin// sgo gsum longs spyod dge rtsar bcas// gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// nyon mongs dbang gyur thog med nas// sdig sgrib nyes ltung ci bsags par// gnong 'gyod drag pos snying nas bshags// dag cing tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// skye (137)'phags rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// zag bcas zag pa med pa yi// bsod nams gang bsags thams cad la// dga' ba chen pos rjes yi rang*// zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi sgo// khyad par theg mchog bla na med// gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa bzhin// rgyun chad med par ston par bskul// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo ma zhig bar// de srid snying rje'i gzhan dbang gis// zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzhol bar// rtag cing brtan par bzhugs gsol 'debs// 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus// myur du byang chub mchog thob nas// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog / ces yan lag bdun pa ci mang dang*/ thun mong gis maṇ+ḍal spyi ltar rgyas bsdus lan mang du phul rjes nang gi maṇ+ḍal ni/ skad cig gis ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa lag tu byung*/ des rang lus dum bur byas nas maṇ+ḍal du bkod par gyur/ hūm̐ masta ka su me ru ya bā ma bā da bi de haḥ ra hi ni pā da dzam+pu dwī pa/ a pash+tsi ma dwī pa hi na ha sta/ la bā ma hasta ku ru urta ra/

shūtra ku su ma tsan+d+ra sūr+ya bhū ṣi taṃ/ zhes tshom bu bkod par mos la/ i daṃ gu ru rat+na āt+ma naṃ kā ya maṇ+ḍal nir+ya ta yā mi/ zhes dbul zhing slar yang*/ rang lus rnam smin phung po'i ka pā la// lings skyis phog dbus lhag ma'i lus phung rnams// ril por bcug la yi ge 'bru gsum gyis// sbyangs rtogs spar zhu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum du brjod/ ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bar gyur par bsam la/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥshrī mā na saṅgu ru ma hrā sid+dhi mā na sa ra ha sa pa ri wā ri bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba li ga ṇa tsakra ma hā pū dza khā hi/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ 'dir phyi nang gi mchod pa ci 'byor bas mchod par (138)bgyi gsungs pas rgyas par spro na mchod phreng gi tshig ci rigs sbyar/ dkyus su/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis// rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar byung*// me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa// rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog /puṣ+pe sogs sbyar/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min cing*// lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis// nges par sregs pa de yi spos// thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul// yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal// mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas// byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*// de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa ni// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod// dbang po thams cad yang dag bstan// de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje// bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya// 'gog pa'i rdo rjer gugs pa'i sems// rang nyams dpyid kyi dpa' bo'i glu// gzhom med na dā'i sgra dbyangs kyis// thugs kyi rdo rje'i mchod par bgyi//

nang mchod bdud rtsi phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni// dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso// nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing*// bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga// shes rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi// mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma phul bar mos la/ lha mo 'di dag phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rigs lnga las byung 'di phul bas// rig pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin shog /lha dang mi yi bde ba ni// bsdus byas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// bcu drug char yang mi phod pa'i// dga' ba bla na med pas mchod// ces gsang ba'i mchod pa bya/ bstod pa grub chen so so'i sngags brjod bye brag pa sogs gang shes dang*/ spyi tsam du/ zab zhi spros dang bral ba gnyug ma'i don// snang dang stong pa gnyis dang gnyis min la// e ma ho 'di snyam bral (139)ba'i lta ba can// bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyed la 'dud// smra bsam brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin la// bde stong 'dzin pa med pa bde ba'i nyams// e ma ho rtsol bral lhug ma'i sgom pa can// bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyed la 'dud// spang blang byar med rang bzhin 'od gsal la// gzung 'dzin glo bur dri ma rnam dag pa// e ma ho rang bzhin lhun grub 'bras bu can// bde chen lhan skyes rol pa khyed la 'dud// ces pa tsam bya/ slar yang yan lag bdun pa bya bar gsungs pas rgyas bsdus gang lcogs sbyor chog /dkyus tsam du/ oṃ āḥdapal ldan rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal// skyobs pa chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun rje la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'os sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos rnams dang*// tshul khrims bzang ldan dge 'dun ste// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i// sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i// spyan lngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni// mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i sras kyis dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag kun la yang dag yi rangs shing*// byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la// dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du// bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi// bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa myur thob shog

/ ces pa tsam bya/ de nas/ āt+ma naṃ su kha duḥkha te me dzñā (140)ne su kha ki duḥkha to ma thi/ nas+thi sa ra ha na mo stu te/ zhes pa'am bod skad du bsgyur na/ bdag gis bde sdug khyed kyis mkhyen no// bde'am sdug kyang khyod las gzhan ma mchis so// phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud do sa ra ha// zhes pa gang rigs kyis drag tu gsol ba gdab cing*/ gu ru sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tsha mi/ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ āḥm hā sid+dhi la b+dha sa ra ha pā da hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa'i mtshan sngags kyang ci nus su bzla zhing*/ mthar/ bla ma grub brnyes rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga gsal ba'i// g.yon phyogs rkyang ma dang bral kun+da'i khams// sku yi byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'od dkar tshul// smin mtshams nas byung rang gi dpral bar thim// lus kyi sgrib dag bum dbang thob par gyur// g.yas phyogs ro ma dang 'brel rdul gyi khams// gsung gi bdud rtsi 'od dmar tshul du byung*// mgul ba'i gnas nas bdag gi mgrin par thim// ngag gi sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob// a wa dhū ti mun can dngas ma'i tshul// thugs kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'od mthing bcas// thugs ka'i gnas nas snying gar thim pa yis// yid kyi sgrib dag sher dbang ye shes thob// bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// gnyis med bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang du bzhag /sgo gsum 'pho ba'i sgrib dag tshig dbang thob// bla ma rang sems tha mi dad du 'dres// zhes dmigs la bsam med gnyug ma'i rang ngor mnyam par 'jog /de las ldang ba na/ e ma ma la dus gsum dge ba 'dis// bdag dang mar gyur mtha' yas sems can kun// grub pa mchog gis rtag par rjes bzung nas// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub myur thob shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog

/ ces sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i bsngo smon gdab cing shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan no/ ༈ / de bzhin du gzhan 'dra ba la/ mngon rtogs kyi (141)skabs/ pags pa'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub sku mdog sngo sangs nor bu'i kha dog lta bu dwangs shing dri ma med pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya thugs kar 'ching ba/ na bza' chos gos gsum dang bcas shing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa shaṃ kha la sogs pa'i klu'i rgyal po mchog rnams sbrul gyi rnam pas gdengs ka'i grib ma 'bul ba la sku rgyab brten pa/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes man gong bzhin la/ bstod pa'i skabs/ nā gā rdzu na'i zhabs la 'dud// mtshan sngags kyang sa ra ha'i tshab tu// nā gā rdzu na ma gtogs gzhan gong dang 'dra ba nyid do// ༈ /de bzhin sha ba ri la'ang*/ bla ma dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ri khrod pa chen po/ 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid mtshon pa'i sku mdog nag po/ dbu skra ral pa spyi bor bcings pa smyug ma'i shun pas bsdams pa/ spyan 'bru tshugs su gzigs shing spyan rtsa dmar ba/ phyag gnyis mda' dang 'od ma'i gzhu mchog la phag rgod kyi khog stong dang khog smad bkal ba/ rma bya'i mdangs sgro gshibs pa'i sham thabs dang*/ me tog 'bras bu'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan te 'gyings bag dang bcas pa'i rol stabs su bzhugs pa/ sku'i g.yas g.yon nas rig ma rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs shig mda' dong 'dzin pa gnyis kyis brten pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba man 'dra/ ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs la 'dud// sha ba ri pā da zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra/ bstod pa'i skabs spro na nags rin gyis mdzad pa'i sha ba ri pa'i bstod chen sogs kyang 'don no/ ༈ /de bzhin du grub chen nag po spyod pa la'ang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i grub pa'i slob dpon brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang phyug kah+na pa chen po sku mdog nag po dpa' zhing sgeg pa hur bag chags pa phyag g.yas cang te'u 'khrol zhing*/

g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa'i mchan (142)khung du rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsgreng ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can sku la mi rus kyi phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs gsol ba/ pi shwa rū pi nī zhes bya ba'i srin mo'i gtso mo 'jigs su rung ba gdan nam bzhon pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i steng na rol stabs su bzhugs pa/ res 'ga' ro langs chen po me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa la chibs pa sogs sna tshogs pa'i rnam 'phrul ston par mdzad bzhin pa'i/ steng gi nam mkha' la gdugs bdun 'dzin pa med par 'khor zhing*/ ḍā ma ru bdun 'khrol ba po med par rang 'khrol ba/ res 'ga' gdugs bdun brgyad ḍā ma ru bdun brgyar 'phel ba'i cho 'phrul can/ snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya dang mi snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya la sogs pa grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo grangs med dbus na rol ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba

man 'dra/ spyod 'chang dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud// tsar+ya badz+ra ram/ kah+nar+ya ka pā da zhes sbyar ba dang*/ ༈ gnyis su med pa grub pa'i dbang phyug bi rū pa chen po sku mdog smug nag sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ dbu skra co bregs la me tog gi phreng bas spud pa/ lhag ma rgyan spangs shing phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub kyi phyag rgya gdengs pas nyi ma brtod la gnon pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon pa man gyi rwa zhal chang gis gang ba dkur brten pa/ sha na'i gos kyis 'doms dkris can rol pa'i 'dug stangs su bzhugs pa/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas rig ma chang snod 'dzin pas 'dud pa'i tshul can/ lhan cig skyes pa'i man 'dra/ bi rū pa la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bi rū pā da zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom+bhi he ru ka sku mdog dkar dmar ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i sbrul reg pa'i dug can gyis rgyan du mdzad cing*/ mthong ba'i (143)dug can lcag gi tshul du bsnams pa/ kha rlangs kyi dug can bdun gyis dbu'i steng du gdangs gar byas shing*/ stag mo mi bzad 'jigs su rung ba la chibs pa'i brla g.yon pa'i steng nas gsang ba'i gzungs ma g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma gcer mo pad+ma can gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pas dam du 'khyud cing 'khril ba'i bde bas dgyes rgur rol pa/ lhan cig skyes man 'dra/ ḍom+bhi pa la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ḍom+bhi he ru ka pā da zhes bsgyur/ ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug lū hi pa chen po sku mdog sngo sangs skems shing rid pa'i tshul can ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad dang bcas shing ras kyi smad dkris gsol ba/ sku'i mdun phyogs su nya'i rgyu lto spungs pa las phyag gis blangs te zhal du gsol ba'i rnam pa can phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes man 'dra ba la/ lū hi pa la phyag 'tshal 'dud// lū hi pā da

zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ ༈ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug gau rak+ṣa nā tha sku mdog dkar sngo snum pa'i mdangs can shangs rgyud mtho zhing 'dzum bag gi mdangs dang ldan pa/ ag tshom dang dbu skra ljang ser/ lta stangs cer re pa/ snyan la mu dra nag po dang*/ mgul du siṅga nā da'i rwa dung 'chang zhing sku la tsakra kan+ta ste 'khor lo lta bu'i bem po gsol ba/ sgom shing la kos go brten pa'i tshul gyis skyil krung dang bcas drang por bzhugs shing*/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi steng na ku ba'i snod thogs pa/ mthong ba'i mod la nyams dga' zhing tha mal gyi snang ba hrul por 'jig pa/ lhan cig skyes pa man 'dra/ gau rak+ṣa la gus pas 'dud// gau rak+ṣa nā tha pā da bsgyur ba dang*/ ༈ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po tin+ti pa sngo sangs shin tu smin pa'i na tshod can gyi sku lus/ ag tshom dang sma ra ring du 'phyang ba dbu skyes dang bcas pa rab tu dkar ba'i mdangs can/ ras kyi smad dkris gsol zhing (144)khri 'thags kyi bya ba la brtson pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa sogs dang*/ tan+ti pa la gus pas 'dud/ tan+ti ka pā da sogs/ ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug dril bu pa sku mdog sngo sangs ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum pad+ma can gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pa dkar gsal lta bas chog mi shes pa la 'khyud de mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs can zhes dang*/ dril bu pa la phyag 'tshal 'dud// badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa pā da zhes so// ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dzā lan+da ra sku mdog dkar dmar ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus pa'i rgyan can ras dmar po'i 'doms dkris gsol ba/ zhabs phyogs gcig rgyab nas dpung par bkal zhing phyogs gcig bzhengs pa'i tshul can/

phyag gnyis rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya ldog ste spyi bor 'chings pa/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas rig ma rnal 'byor ma'i cha byad can gyis 'dud bzhin pa zhes dang*/ dzā lan+dā ra'i zhabs la 'dud// dzā lan+dha ra pā da zhes so// ༈ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pa sku mdog sngo sangs rus pa'i rgyan dang ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyed skyil gyis bzhugs shing thod pa 'dzin pa'i pang du rdo rje yan lag ma ku ku ri gzhon nu'i gzugs can bzung ste dgyes rgur rol pa/ zhes dang*/ ku ku rī par phyag 'tshal 'dud// ku ku ri pā da zhes so// ༈ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po lwa ba pa sku mdog dkar dmar tshangs pa spyod pa'i cha byad can/ sku la lwa ba'i dum bu brgya phrag bsdus te drubs pa'i na bza' gsol zhing phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas skyil mo krung bcas te gnyid 'thug gi zol gyis 'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'i (145)tshul can/ zhes dang*/ lwa ba pa la phyag 'tshal 'dud// kam+pa la pā da bsgyur ba dang*/ ༈ nyer spyod mtha' klas pas brgyan pa'i dbus su grub pa'i slob dpon chen po in+d+ra bhū ti mi'i bdag po stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad sku mdog dkar dmar mdzes shing brjid la chags pa'i nyams can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan spras te nor bu'i khri stan mtho zhing yangs la bkod legs pa'i steng du bde lugs su bzhugs pa'i sku'i mtha' bskor du bud med rin po che'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i btsun mo'i tshogs lnga brgyas bskor ba 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la rjes su chags pas rtag tu dgyes rgur rol pa'i rnam pa can/ zhes dang*/ in+d+ra bhu ti la phyag 'tshal// shrī na ren+d+ra bhū ti pā da/ zhes so// ༈ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dpal bde ba chen po pad+ma kī ra sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu gang zhing rgyas la/

pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i spyan ras dang mchu sgros mnga' ba/ dbu'i dpral ba'i dbyibs su rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i re khās spras zhing*// sku'i cha shas thams cad du pad+ma ut+pal lcags kyu zhags pa la sogs pa'i sha mtshan dge ba sha stag gis spras pa/ kāṇ+ṭa ka'i cod pan mnabs shing*/ gsang gos kyi steng du chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga la thugs kar gdengs shing*/ g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dkur brten pa'i mchan du rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bcug pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku'i g.yas g.yon nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i pad+ma nī bcu drug pa'i lang tsho can gyis brten pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sogs dang*/ pad+mā kar ra phyag 'tshal 'dud/ shrī ma hā su kha pad+ma badz+ra pā da zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ ༈ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po bi rū pa/ dbu la rdo rje (146)thod ces bya ba rten 'brel gyi byin rlabs kyi cod pan sngon po gsol zhing*/ phyag g.yas ba men gyi rwa ba bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin zhing gsol ba/ g.yon pus mo'i steng du bzhag pa/ sku'i mdun du ka pā la ma hā ba las gang ba bzhag cing*/ dbu skra co breg lpags pa'i gdan dang 'doms dkris can/ lhag ma rgyan dang na bza' spangs shing rnal 'byor pa hur bag chags pa'i rnam pa/ sku'i g.yon nas rig ma thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas pa/ lhan cig sogs dang*/ nag po bi rū pa la 'dud// kṛṣ+ṇa pi rū pā da zhes bsgyur/ ༈ brgyan pa'i dbus su grub pa'i dbang phyug til+li pa chen po sku mdog chen po sku mdog sngon ga dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ras kyi aṅga rag gsol zhing ming 'greng gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'phags te til brdung ba'i rnam pa can/ sku'i mdun du rig ma til mkhan mo'i rnam pas bar snang la gnas bzhin tu til lugs pa'i bya ba la brtson pa dang thabs cig tu lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ji ltar 'byung ba'i brda ston par mdzad pa/

bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi sogs dang*/ til+li pa la phyag 'tshal lo// til+li ku pā da hūm̐ hūm̐/ ༈ grub ba'i slob dpon chen po dpal nā ro pa sku mdog smug nag lta bar mi bzod pa'i zil dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras shing dar gyi aṅga rag gsol ba/ zhing chen gyi pags pa bshus ma thag pa khrag 'dzags pa stod g.yogs kyi tshul du mnabs pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas phyag gis bzung ste phan tshun du brgyangs pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i gar stabs can/ lhan cig skyes sogs dang*/ nā ro pa yi zhabs la 'dud// nā ro pā da zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ ༈ dbus su grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dpal shrān+ti pa sku mdog sngo skya gnas brtan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ cung zad smin pa'i na tshod can gyi rnam pa chos gos rnam pa gsum dang paṇ+ḍi ta'i cod (147)pan mnabs shing*/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te ta la'i byang bur bris pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis gding ba la bzhugs pa dang*/ shīn+ti pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rat+na ā ga ra shān+ti pā zhes sbyar/ de bzhin tu/ ༈ brgyan pa'i dbus su slob dpon chen po shrī satwa nā tha shān+ti gup+ta sku mdog smug nag /rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan tho re bas spras pa/ sku sha nyams rgyas shing brjid la hur bag chags pa/ dbu skra co breg ras kyis 'doms dkris gru gsum pa gsol zhing zhabs gnyis bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis rin po che'i khri la pags pa'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya thugs kar 'ching ba/ lhan cig skyes sogs dang*/ shān+ti gup+ta la phyag 'tshal// shrī satwa nā tha shān+ti gup+ta hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes sbyar/ ༈ de bzhin du/ pags pa'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i slob dpon chen po shrī bud+dha gup+ta dzo gi'i cha byad can sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/

sku bong che zhing lhun chags la dang ba 'dren pa/ mthong ba'i mod la ba spu g.yo zhing skyi bung zhes byed pa'i bril dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs su bcings pa'i rtse mo nas ral pa'i zar bu cung zad rgyab tu 'phyang ba/ me tog ser po kha bye ma thag pa'i thod bcings gsol pa/ bgres rgud spangs pa'i lang tshos gang ba lag nas shing hur bag chags pa/ ras kyi 'doms dkris dang na bza' gsol zhing pus 'khyud can/ phyag g.yas sa gnon pus steng du bkab cing g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dkur brten pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ sku drangs por bsrangs te skyil krung phyed pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sogs dang*/ bud+dha gup+tar gus phyag 'tshal// shrī bud+dha gup+ta nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes sbyar ba ma gtogs (148)gong dang 'dra'o// 'di rnams kyis mtshon nas rang rang gis dmigs bsal du dad pa'i yul sogs grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gang la'ang sbyor du rung bar gsungs pas/ so so'i mngon rtogs dang mtshan dang mtshan sngags kha spos pas chog go /dge bas grub pa mchog rnams kyi// byin rlabs bdag gi rgyud la zhugs// rtogs grol dus mnyam mkha' spyod tshe'i// grong khyer nyams dgar dbugs dbyung shog /tshul 'di lta bu'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdzad byang mi gsal yang rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i gsungs zin yin nges par bzhugs pa la tshigs zin gyi kha skong 'os rigs 'thad ldan rnams dkyus su btsud pa'i bklags chog nyid du blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong gsal bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwar bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
